notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS that provides an integrated knowledge layer for customer support platforms. Started with Hosted API POC (Jan-Feb) focused on embeddings + semantic search; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

Top priorities: embeddings accuracy, nightly batch indexing performance, vector DB compatibility, cost per embed, and SSO + audit requirements for enterprise customers. Wants US data residency.

POC outcomes (hosted API):
- Ingested ~50k docs (Markdown + PDFs) via nightly batch pipeline.
- Batch embedding job: observed ~120 qps effective throughput when batched at 512; per-embed latency ~40ms on hosted model; peak window caused timeouts on our pipeline during concurrent index + query jobs.
- Semantic search (kNN) latency 40-120ms depending on vector DB and cache hit. Pinecone test cluster used for POC.
- Quality: liked open-model embedding variants; asked about Redwood-verified embedding models and dimensionality tradeoffs.

Architecture & integrations:
- Current infra: Snowflake for raw content, Airflow for batch orchestration, Pinecone for vector store, Redis for short-term caching.
- Needs connector guidance: Snowflake -> batch embeddings, incremental delta updates, retention + TTL for embeddings, efficient upserts to vector DB.
- Interested in Redwood's autoscaling + prefix/KV caching to reduce per-token cost for query-side workloads.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must pass security questionnaire (attached). Require SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs retention >= 1 year, KMS-backed encryption for keys, and US-East/US data residency.
- Legal asked for flow diagram and breach response details — provided redacted diagrams in drive link.

Commercial/ops:
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement; wants predictable monthly committed price for Dedicated vs variable Hosted billing. Interested in 12-month reserved commit if unit economics are clear.
- Asked for model fallback policy when Dedicated capacity is saturated.

Quotes from calls: "We need predictable throughput for peak support hours — spikes every weekday 10-14:00 PT."  — Head of Product.
